selection.energy_windows: Existing fixed measured line-energy windows, half-width max(5 keV, 2% of center).

methods.reconstruction: Existing measured fits, pairing/order weights, angular kernel and per-cone finite-grid normalization.
methods.support: Nominal trigger units. Near-peak and near-source are closed 20 mm XY disks. Edge cells are the outer row/column, edge band is the outer 20 mm, and outside-saved-grid uses the original footprint. Regions can overlap.

methods.perturbations: Each leave-one-out removes the entire original trigger including all alternatives. methods.fit_residual: Saved center waveform residual RMS is scaled by the existing optional output-noise RMS. Successful optimizers can still produce large waveform mismatch.
methods.peak_cell_concentration: Inverse sum of squared original trigger shares. Descriptive concentration, independent sample size unavailable.
methods.photon_truth: Input group ordinals are original archive joins and can cover many groups. No photon interaction histories or per-order truth labels were used. No transport, fields, drift, calibration or waveform fits were re-run.

maps.array_order: rows increase in y, columns increase in x; positions refer to cell centers

model.direction_domain: full sphere; no known source side, plane, symmetry or activity
model.method: Finite-vertex per-trigger angular mixture; preserve order and unresolved mass. Profile center distance while reoptimizing direction. No finite-image normalization.
model.uncertainty: Default strip quantization plus nominal angular width; depth and energy uncertainties uncalibrated. Scores are not calibrated probabilities or intervals.

uncertainty_controls.definition: All signed differences are measured minus injected. Site numbering follows input order for comparison only. Point mixtures are generated from archived native traces at a common onset and read with the existing ADC.
uncertainty_controls.scope: Within-group and between-group statistics are sample summaries for the listed simulated conditions. The repeated noise, phase and energy conditions share geometries. No intervals, detector covariance, or threshold transfer.
uncertainty_controls.validation_groups: The 48 general controls use four physically distinct two-point geometries, each with 12 readout conditions. Each targeted Cs trial has a unique point pair within one fixed pair of cells; these trials remain one whole holdout group. Negative mixtures use additional disjoint coordinates and nominal ADC noise.

additional_lateral_controls.scope: Four independent physical layouts, two energy divisions and two ADC phases. Coordinates are distinct from every earlier clean and mixed-topology control and every fitted native template.

full_lateral_acceptance.method: Exact original saved ADC population, line memberships, measured pairings, Compton orders and nominal weights; optional six-grid lateral positions with center fallback. Center/lateral comparison uses the recorded center-mode artifacts. No truth used to fit or choose either branch.
full_lateral_acceptance.limitations: Only six pixels carry evaluated lateral corrections. Different runtime versions can affect numerical optima. Angular model, range profiles and positions remain uncalibrated; no experimental localization or range validation.

full_map_selection.energy_windows: Existing fixed measured line-energy windows, half-width max(5 keV, 2% of center).

grid.array_order: rows increase in y, columns increase in x; positions refer to cell centers

injection_energy_control.limits: These point-input residuals lack full-photon transport and the continuous acquisition background, so they supply a readout-control scale. The original energy-window offsets can include escaped or mixed photon energy. No detector energy resolution, reclassification, or new gate is inferred.
injection_energy_control.study: Clean simultaneous two-point injection mixtures at the same nominal ADC calibration. Conditions repeat or share geometry.

energy_offsets.scope: Every retained trigger in each original line window and every retained measured order. Offsets are measured energy minus the window center. Cumulative curves reference the original fixed peak cell and include zero contributors. Energy offsets do not choose isotope, photon identity, orders, or a new cut.

limits: The full saved canonical source stream, original before/after CLHEP state and target native-input SHA agree in every replay. Raw transport LH5 container hashes differ.
Process attribution comes from direct-child birth metadata and coincident scored gamma chord ends. Geant4 step rows lack an interaction process or photon kinetic-energy column.
Emitted-minus-Ge-deposition energy is an accounting difference. Nearest strip centers describe geometric proximity.
Exactly one Ge deposit group intersects each ADC context. Earlier electronics tails were not isolated. No drift or electronics response was rerun.
Known source position is used only to score the original saved candidate cone. Each group of five triggers was chosen by original peak contribution.

model.scope: Same ten peak-selected triggers and original geometry/weights. Raw truncated-normal angle response is a conditional model density, not detector probability. Grid sum has no solid-angle or area quadrature factor. Source coordinates only score completed candidates; no cuts or map edits.

conditional_escape_geometry.angular_residual_definition: Angle from fitted first vertex to comparison position relative to the cone axis, minus kinematic half-angle.
conditional_escape_geometry.scope: Three selected peak triggers with verified original photon ancestry. The 18 separately sealed chronological triggers in reconstruction have no origin scoring in this receipt.

exact_photon_controls.definition: Exact per-vertex transport transfer is pre-step minus post-step photon kinetic energy. Source alignment, the transport versus stationary-electron angular discrepancy, and the reconstruction substitutions are calculated separately.

model.assumptions: Free stationary electrons and nominal cell energies. Uncertainties, charge loss, prior scatters, merged scatters and mixed photons are outside these point-hypothesis calculations. The angles are conditional kinematics.
model.incident_line_closure: The signed difference is measured cell sum minus the specified incident energy. No tolerance or line assignment is applied.
model.observed_sum_full_absorption: One Compton scatter followed by full absorption. Incident energy is the sum of the two cells.
model.two_resolved_scatter_escape: At each cell a single scatter deposits its measured energy. Escaping photon energy must stay positive.

methods.measured_pair: Original X/Y face assignments and ADC-derived cell energies. Incompatible face assignments retain their measurements but lack a coherent two-cell energy hypothesis.
methods.origin_score: Independent photon histories enter only after the saved-population ledger and original peak summaries are complete.
methods.peak_support: Each original order contributes to one set of admissible supplied escape energies. Empty sets represent orders outside all supplied nominal escape hypotheses.
methods.projections: All original plane weights and statuses are retained. A nominal energy check supplies neither a new projection nor a fitted source or event classification.

photon_origin_score.scope: Peak-selected photon histories, descriptive checks only. The physical cell sequence can contain merged scatters.

historical_truth_control.scope: Historical independent replay; repeated occurrences share original transport interactions. The measured fits stay fixed before every truth substitution.
historical_truth_control.arm_definition: Angle from cone axis to programmed source minus energy-derived Compton opening; degrees. Measured cones for incomplete absorption are apparent two-site absorption hypotheses.
historical_truth_control.energy_definition: Ge interaction and endpoint-cell deposit sums are explicit same-event controls. They can differ from one another and from the unsaved photon kinetic energy at the vertices.

fresh_five_second_truth_join.basis: Retained fresh candidate group ordinals mark recent readout context. A unique causal photon-to-trigger link is necessary before replacing the measured geometry or energy.
